'''Ice Mountains Peaks''' is the highest peak of Johto, and the end of climbing the stairs within the cave of [[Ice Mountains]].

If the player acquired the Azure Flute from Eusine in [[Cherrygrove City]], the North-East cavern will lead to the summit of the Ice Mountain. Blowing the Azure Flute in the summoning circle will open a path in the sky to the [[Hall of Origin]] for a static encounter with Arceus.
